_why: The head camera's installation offset, subtracted from the fitted fruit centre. Measured on the reference bench (logs/p135/perception_bench.py) as the fitted centre's world offset from the rigid body's origin: +6.5 mm in +y, stable across the pool on this mount and lens. A different camera, mount or lens needs its own number; `FRUIT_PERCEPTION_BIAS=x,y,z` overrides it per run.
_why_wrist: The eye-in-hand camera's own mount offset. It must be re-measured when the mount's *aim* changes: at the first aim (3 cm past the jaw) the fruit left the frame during the descent (94 -> 402 px, 729 refusals) and the offset was (-1.5,+3.3,-6.2) mm; aimed 10-16 cm ahead along the approach axis the fruit fills the frame (1684-3241 px, 2-3 refusals) and the offset is (+0.8,+2.6,-0.3) mm, with a 0.9 mm diameter error. The same camera, a different bracket.
